Six comments

Tara Lynn’s March to God

This Cape Breton march was written by Lee Cremo.

↳ Posted by Tate on March 24th, 2013.

Lee Cremo Playing

You can here Lee Cremo himself playing it the 2:49 mark in the video. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BIbx1Ngc-8U

↳ Posted by Tate on March 24th, 2013.

This tune can be found in the Cape Breton Fiddlers Collection from Cranford Publications.

↳ Posted by Tate on March 27th, 2013.

A different title?

The title on the clip at 3.02 says it is “The Hills of Glenorchy” (traditional). Presumably another name?

↳ Posted by Dennis Reynolds on March 27th, 2013.

Hills of Glenorchy

Nope, definitely the wrong name in the video. Here’s the Hills of Glenorchy https://thesession.org/tunes/842 definetly a different tune. Tara Lynn’s March to God is the title in the Cape Breton Fiddlers Collection.

↳ Posted by Tate on March 27th, 2013.

My Own Personal Version

The second version is my own arrangement, with my own flair added to Lee’s tune. Some of the grace notes in A5 and A9 don’t work properly on this site, but will work properly in the mandolintab.net convertor.

↳ Posted by Tate on June 9th, 2013.

The original link is thesession.org/tunes/12620
